description:
One unchanged OCI-layout tar preserves the runnable image and attestation index through runtime smoke and disposable-registry proof.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: After identity preflight, pinned Buildx/BuildKit exports one Linux/amd64 type=oci tar labeled with the freeze revision/version and max provenance/SPDX SBOM, without load, registry push, save, or repack.
- [hard] REQ-02: Evidence records tar SHA-256, D_index, D_run and descriptors; in-toto subjects equal D_run. Pinned Skopeo copies D_run digest-preservingly to rootless Podman for the full runtime matrix—including WORKDIR /repo and seeded issue/document /api/search results—and copies the complete index with --all --preserve-digests to a disposable registry whose digest/descriptors equal D_index.
- [hard] REQ-03: Source tar bytes/index remain unchanged after smoke and are uploaded once under the unique candidate/SHA/producer-run/attempt name with 90-day retention and exact artifact ID/ZIP digest/expiry outputs. GHCR :1.0.0 remains absent and no source/tag/public mutation occurs.

## Notes

Blast radius: one OCI candidate archive, temporary local runtime/registry state, and evidence only.
title: Build and attest the frozen OCI candidate
